svg.title: The critical friend's journey
svg.desc: 7 steps in rows, each giving where you are in the playbook, what you do and what you produce. 1. The critical friend What you are confirming: You give independent advice. You are not delivering the analysis. Produces: Nothing recorded yet. 2. The critical friend Independence: The separation follows the level, from a colleague to external review. Produces: Your name on the design and plan, before work starts. 3. Phase 2 Design: Review the plan. Confirm the approach and assurance level are right. Produces: A reviewed assurance plan, and your time in the schedule. 4. The checks, by level: Run the checks the level asks for, and the levels inside it. Produces: Your entries in the quality assurance log. 5. Phase 3 Analysis: You shall review the analyst's assurance and report errors and improvements back. Produces: Your findings, and the analyst's response to each one. 6. R9 Uncertainty: Check assumptions are traceable, and uncertainty quantified where the method allows. Produces: A recorded view on whether uncertainty is handled adequately. 7. Phase 4 Delivery, communication and sign-off: State the assurance: appropriately scoped, executed, validated, verified and documented. Produces: The quality assurance statement, or your part of it. After the last step: What you report back is what the next piece of work avoids.
